energy_demand_in_kilowatt_hour_per_year.source: all_kpis.json: 'Purchased energy consumption for simulated period'; delivered energy bought over every carrier (Q22), summed by HiSim from 'Total energy from grid', 'Total gas demand from grid', 'Total energy consumption'; scaled to a year by 1 / 0.00273785

emissions_in_kg_co2_per_year.source: all_kpis.json: 'Total CO2 emissions for simulated period'; operational CO2 (Q22), computed with the 'DE' emission factors of hisim/components/configuration.py, which are not the 'IE' grid's: that table has no 'IE' row; scaled to a year by 1 / 0.00273785

self_sufficiency_in_percent.source: all_kpis.json: 'Self-sufficiency rate of electricity'; a rate, so it is not scaled to a year

embodied_co2_in_kg.source: insulation_materials.json co2_footprint_in_kg_per_m3 x layer volume (Q22): FACADE polystyrene_eps_rigid_board 50 mm x 173 m2 (EXTERNAL_INSULATION) = 8.65 m3 x 59.806 kg/m3; ROOF wood_fiber_rigid_board 160 mm x 98 m2 (ROLLED_OUT_ATTIC_INSULATION) = 15.68 m3 x -174.8 kg/m3

energy_label.source: no BER/DEAP procedure in HiSim; no letter is invented (A12)

investment_costs_in_euro.source: devices from the cost engine (Irish device and energy prices are AI estimates (src_ai_estimates) and are not reviewed); envelope material only, from insulation_materials.json investment_cost_in_euro_per_m3; no labour, scaffolding or system parts until the materials database gains its total-cost column (Q8/Q9): FACADE polystyrene_eps_rigid_board 50 mm x 173 m2 (EXTERNAL_INSULATION) = 8.65 m3 x 107-172 EUR/m3 [IE]; ROOF wood_fiber_rigid_board 160 mm x 98 m2 (ROLLED_OUT_ATTIC_INSULATION) = 15.68 m3 x 260-660 EUR/m3 [IE]

devices.source: cash_flow_timeline.csv: year 0 INVESTMENT entries under 'greenfield_gross'; Irish device and energy prices are AI estimates (src_ai_estimates) and are not reviewed

envelope_material.source: material only, from insulation_materials.json investment_cost_in_euro_per_m3; no labour, scaffolding or system parts until the materials database gains its total-cost column (Q8/Q9): FACADE polystyrene_eps_rigid_board 50 mm x 173 m2 (EXTERNAL_INSULATION) = 8.65 m3 x 107-172 EUR/m3 [IE]; ROOF wood_fiber_rigid_board 160 mm x 98 m2 (ROLLED_OUT_ATTIC_INSULATION) = 15.68 m3 x 260-660 EUR/m3 [IE]

energy_costs_in_euro_per_year.source: cash_flow_timeline.csv: year 1 nominal ENERGY_WORKING, ENERGY_STANDING, ENERGY_CO2_PRICE, ENERGY_CAPACITY_CHARGE entries under 'greenfield_gross'; Irish device and energy prices are AI estimates (src_ai_estimates) and are not reviewed

maintenance_costs_in_euro_per_year.source: cash_flow_timeline.csv: year 1 nominal MAINTENANCE entries under 'greenfield_gross'; Irish device and energy prices are AI estimates (src_ai_estimates) and are not reviewed

net_present_value_in_euro.source: lifecycle_costs.json: greenfield_gross.total_npv_in_euro over 20 years; Irish device and energy prices are AI estimates (src_ai_estimates) and are not reviewed

monthly_net_cost_20y_in_euro.source: lifecycle_costs.json: greenfield_gross.equivalent_annual_cost_in_euro / 12 over 20 years; Irish device and energy prices are AI estimates (src_ai_estimates) and are not reviewed

monthly_net_cost_10y_in_euro.source: economic_inputs.json re-evaluated over 10 years under 'greenfield_gross': equivalent_annual_cost_in_euro / 12; Irish device and energy prices are AI estimates (src_ai_estimates) and are not reviewed
